title: Genesis 6:16 (ark window, door, decks) and Exodus 13:21 (pillar of cloud and fire)
summary: Genesis 6:16 in English (God's instructions to make a window, a door in the side, and lower, second and third decks for the ark, with 'ar' in 'ark' in red) above Exodus 13:21, where the LORD goes before the people in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.

text.text: 16 “You shall make a window for the ark, and finish it to a cubit from the top; and set the door of the ark in the side of it; you shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.
21 The LORD was going before them in a pillar of cloud by day to lead them on the way, and in a pillar of fire by night to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night.

keywords: cloud by day fire by night
uncertain: The word 'ark' is shown with 'ar' in red (and 'ark' in the second line also with 'ar' red); the L, O and R of 'LORD' are in different colours (brown, orange, orange). The slide gives no explanation of these colours.
